gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Noto Sans Oriya keeps its curves generously gapped and its small letters nearly as tall as the capitals. Revalia, bold and expressive, strides across widely separated letters above it, so the page gets one loud voice and one approachable one.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-osage: Friendly and a bit inflated, Noto Sans Osage fills each line with round lowercase bowls and sweeping curves that never close up. If Revalia were shrunk down, its bold, widely spaced display letters would lose their swagger beside that body.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-osmanya: That open-bottomed g in Revalia is the giveaway, a bold, expressive display face with a relaxed stride. Noto Sans Osmanya follows in a plain sans, with easy s turns and lowercase that feels oversized, so paragraphs read smoothly.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-hmong: Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong sets a high x-height and rounds that gap open like a cracked bangle, all contemporary and neutral. And Revalia, bold and expressive in display form, supplies the loud heading that this sans-serif body quietly backs up.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Loud heading, tidy body: Revalia stretches out bold and expressive, with a g left open at the bottom, over a modern text face. Noto Sans Palmyrene feels compact beside it.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-hau: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau keeps its curves open and its capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Revalia, the bold and expressive display heading above, spreads its letters wide and relaxed, so the sans below reads as quiet, modern company.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Revalia is bold and expressive, with a relaxed stride. Noto Sans PhagsPa then settles into a plain sans text, with see-through c openings and a gentle bump up to capitals, so a long passage moves along easily.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Bold personality comes from Revalia, a display face with an open-curved g and widely separated letters across the top. But Noto Sans Phoenician holds the text as a modern plain sans, its s curves opening wide and its lowercase standing generously tall.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pahl: Big display swagger over gaping e mouths: Revalia is bold and expressive, while Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi stays approachable, with capitals that barely rise. And that gap between loud and easygoing is exactly what the pair does best.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Noto Sans Rejang brings lowercase counters like wide glass portholes and clear open gaps in its curves, a professional, contemporary plain sans. Revalia above it is bold and wide-striding, a vivid contrast.
